version.name: PE Buyout Workflow Engineering Spec
version.scope: State machine and typed workstream dependency graph for a private-equity buyout process.
version.status: Implementation-ready workflow backbone; object types remain provisional until ontology integration.

edge_mode_enum.BLOCKS: Target cannot be completed until source output exists or explicit exception is recorded.
edge_mode_enum.BLOCKS_FINAL_OUTPUT: Target may start, but final/approval-ready output is blocked.
edge_mode_enum.BLOCKS_FINAL_OUTPUT_WHEN_MATERIAL: Target final output is blocked only if the dependency is material to the decision/economics.
edge_mode_enum.CONDITIONAL_BLOCKS: Edge blocks only when condition evaluates true.
edge_mode_enum.PARALLEL_SOFT: Source and target can run in parallel; unresolved critical output may block later decision.
edge_mode_enum.ITERATIVE_RETURN: Source output can reopen an upstream reasoning node when material.
edge_mode_enum.LOOP_RETURN: Target returns updated baseline to an earlier live loop.

node_schema.name: human-readable workstream name
node_schema.node_type: one of: control_workstream | analysis_input_workstream | decision_preparation_workstream | coordination_and_reasoning_workstream | diligence_workstream | control_and_diligence_workstream | conditional_control_workstream | conditional_diligence_workstream | execution_design_workstream | synthesis_workstream | authority_workstream | execution_workstream | recordkeeping_and_capital_workstream | portfolio_loop_workstream | post_close_decision_workstream | outcome_workstream
node_schema.primary_question: decision-relevant question answered by the node
node_schema.typed_inputs: array of object types, fields, or artifacts consumed
node_schema.typed_outputs: array of object types, fields, or artifacts emitted
node_schema.can_run_in_parallel_with: array of node IDs or explicitly named auxiliary activities that may run concurrently
node_schema.hard_blockers: node IDs, artifact requirements, or conditions that block completion
node_schema.soft_dependencies: inputs that guide the work but do not necessarily block start
node_schema.downstream_consumers: array of workstream node IDs that consume the output
node_schema.failure_modes: specific failure modes to detect or warn on

edge_schema.artifact_dependency: typed object, field, or artifact required or emitted
edge_schema.blocking_condition: condition under which the edge constrains the target
edge_schema.parallel_allowed: whether source and target may run concurrently

nodes.name: Access / confidentiality
nodes.primary_question: May the team receive, store, review, and use non-public materials?
nodes.start_condition: Deal requires confidential materials or data-room access.
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Block confidential ingestion until access is granted or public-only waiver is recorded.

nodes.name: Source case ingestion
nodes.primary_question: What is the initial investment case being proposed, and what claims must be tested?
nodes.start_condition: At least one source material exists and access basis is known.
nodes.done_condition: Materials indexed and initial claims extracted.
failure_modes: source claims treated as validated facts
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Require provenance flag for each source claim.

nodes.name: Initial assessment / screening
nodes.primary_question: Should the deal consume diligence resources?
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Warn/block heavy diligence without screening rationale or exception.

nodes.name: Question engine
nodes.primary_question: What must be answered before the investment decision, and who owns each answer?
nodes.start_condition: Screening approves diligence or a material finding reopens questions.
nodes.done_condition: Every critical question is answered, risk-accepted, or linked to a blocking unresolved status.
failure_modes: new findings do not reopen questions
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Require critical-question status before IC; route material findings back into register.

nodes.name: Financial / QoE
nodes.primary_question: What is the reliable earnings/cash-flow basis for valuation and downside analysis?
nodes.start_condition: Financial materials available and access basis known.
nodes.done_condition: Model-critical financial basis is complete, waived, or risk-accepted.
failure_modes: QoE unavailable but valuation treated as final
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Block final valuation/IC if financial basis is model-critical and unresolved.

nodes.name: Commercial / market
nodes.primary_question: Are growth, pricing, share, customer, competitive and exit-multiple assumptions credible?
nodes.start_condition: Source case contains market/growth claims or valuation depends on market assumptions.
nodes.done_condition: Commercial assumptions needed for valuation are supported, rejected, or risk-accepted.
failure_modes: growth assumed from sponsor case only
commercial finding not reflected in exit multiple or downside case
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Block final valuation if growth/multiple assumptions are material and unsupported.

nodes.name: Operational / KPI / execution feasibility
nodes.primary_question: Can the operational plan, integration, capex, synergy or KPI improvement actually be delivered?
nodes.start_condition: Value creation depends on operational execution, integration, capex, or KPI improvements.
nodes.done_condition: Operational assumptions are supported, rejected, or risk-accepted.
failure_modes: synergies not linked to execution evidence
KPI baseline not preserved for monitoring
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Require operating baseline when value creation depends on operational change.

nodes.name: Management, sponsor and governance assessment
nodes.primary_question: Are the sponsor, management team and governance setup capable and aligned enough to execute the case?
nodes.start_condition: Sponsor/management execution is material to the thesis.
nodes.done_condition: Capability/alignment risks are supported, mitigated, or risk-accepted.
failure_modes: management execution risk not linked to assumptions
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Require sponsor/management risk acceptance when thesis relies heavily on execution credibility.

nodes.name: Legal diligence
nodes.primary_question: Are the legal rights, liabilities, authority, conditions and transaction documents acceptable?
nodes.start_condition: Transaction may progress to signing or legal rights/liabilities affect economics.
nodes.done_condition: Signing-relevant legal issues resolved, waived, or escalated.
failure_modes: material liability not reflected in valuation
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Hard-block signing on legal authority/doc consistency.

nodes.name: Tax / tax structuring
nodes.primary_question: Does tax structure, leakage, filing obligation, liability, or vehicle choice materially affect economics or execution?
nodes.start_condition: Tax is material to economics, filing obligations, vehicle choice, or legal structure.
nodes.done_condition: Material tax impact is resolved, waived, or built into economics/structure.
failure_modes: tax treated as generic checklist when material
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Conditional hard blocker when material; otherwise warn-only checklist.

nodes.name: Financing / debt package
nodes.primary_question: How do debt, leverage, covenants, liquidity, and financing conditions affect returns and downside?
nodes.start_condition: Deal includes leverage, debt refinance, covenant exposure, or financing condition.
nodes.done_condition: Financing terms are reflected in valuation, risk and execution documents.
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Block final model where debt/leverage drives returns or downside and terms are unresolved.

nodes.name: Security / vehicle / rights structuring
nodes.primary_question: What security, ownership, rights, vehicle, fees, and governance terms implement the proposed or approved economics?
nodes.start_condition: Economics or rights depend on security, vehicle, tax, or legal structure.
nodes.done_condition: Structure is sufficiently defined for final valuation and documentation.
failure_modes: security economics not separated from company valuation
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Require security/rights map before final valuation and signing when structure is non-common-equity or rights-sensitive.

nodes.name: Valuation / returns model
nodes.primary_question: What is the risk-adjusted return profile under supported assumptions and security terms?
nodes.start_condition: Initial economics can be modeled; final status requires model-critical dependencies resolved or risk-accepted.
nodes.done_condition: ValuationCase.status == 'IC_ready' AND every model-critical assumption traces to EvidenceItem or RiskAcceptanceRecord.
failure_modes: model starts as sponsor case and never re-underwritten
old-money and new-money not separated in follow-on
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Allow draft model early; block IC-ready model if critical assumptions lack evidence or risk acceptance.

nodes.name: Investment decisioning
nodes.primary_question: Should the investment action be approved, declined, deferred, conditioned, or escalated?
nodes.start_condition: Decision package is submitted or material action requires authority.
soft_dependencies: legal if final docs not yet needed
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Block approval workflow if critical questions, authority, or final model are missing unless risk accepted.

nodes.name: Transaction documentation
nodes.primary_question: Do executed documents correctly implement approved terms and conditions?
nodes.start_condition: An investment action is approved or approved with conditions, or pre-approval drafting is explicitly permitted; signing remains blocked until approval.
nodes.done_condition: Documents signed or execution abandoned; deviations resolved or re-approved.
failure_modes: signature packet exists without economic linkage
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Block funding/position creation until executed authority exists.

nodes.name: Closing / capital administration
nodes.primary_question: What exposure, cost basis, ownership/security, capital account, proceeds or write-off has been created or changed?
nodes.start_condition: Funding/proceeds/closing event or executed docs exist.
nodes.done_condition: Position/capital records reconciled or exception logged.
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Create or update exposure only from executed/funding/proceeds evidence.

nodes.name: Monitoring
nodes.primary_question: How is the live exposure performing versus the underwriting baseline and what events require action?
nodes.done_condition: Periodic monitoring recorded; material signals routed.
failure_modes: valuation mark not tied to evidence
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Trigger re-underwriting on material variance, new capital, covenant/liquidity, exit process or time-based review.

nodes.name: Re-underwriting / update / outcome calibration
nodes.primary_question: Given current evidence versus original underwriting, should the position be held, sold, supported with new money, restructured, impaired or written off?
nodes.start_condition: Material monitoring signal, new decision need, time-based review, exit process or follow-on request.
nodes.done_condition: Recommendation is resolved and routed to monitoring, authority, structuring, transaction documentation, exit realization, or capital administration.
failure_modes: update report treated as an exit without an explicit exit decision
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Treat update and re-underwriting records as re-underwriting objects unless they contain an explicit sell, realization, or write-off decision; route material actions to authority and execution.

nodes.name: Exit / realization
nodes.primary_question: Should the position be sold, partially realized, written off, or held, and what proceeds/residual exposure result?
nodes.start_condition: Sell/exit/write-off recommendation, sale process, or realization event.
nodes.done_condition: Outcome recorded and capital admin/monitoring routes resolved.
hard_blockers: current outcome-calibration analysis for sell recommendation
soft_dependencies: monitoring if external sale process emerges
failure_modes: exit inferred from file label only
nodes.workflow_enforcement: Require current sell/hold rationale and return bridge; do not infer exit from generic update labels.

edges.blocking_condition: source materials are non-public/confidential
edges.enforcement: block confidential ingestion
edges.logic: The team needs permission before ingesting confidential materials.

edges.blocking_condition: screening requires at least one source case or public basis
edges.enforcement: block screening decision if no case material indexed
edges.logic: Screening must evaluate a case, not an empty folder.

edges.blocking_condition: heavy diligence needs a rationale or exception
edges.enforcement: require screening rationale or exception
edges.logic: Questions should flow from an articulated thesis/risk, not passive data-room browsing.

edges.blocking_condition: no financial source set or documented alternative evidence basis exists
edges.enforcement: warn at start; block completed financial output without an evidence basis
edges.logic: Financial diligence requires a defined set of financial claims or records to test.

edges.blocking_condition: no commercial claim set, source material, or explicit external-research mandate exists
edges.enforcement: warn at start; block completed commercial output without a defined evidence mandate
edges.logic: Commercial diligence requires claims, source material, or a defined research mandate.

edges.blocking_condition: management, sponsor, or governance counterparties are not identified
edges.enforcement: warn at start; block completed assessment until the relevant actors are identified
edges.logic: Capability and alignment assessment requires knowing who is responsible for executing and governing the case.

edges.blocking_condition: critical financial question exists
edges.enforcement: route question to financial owner; critical status blocks IC not start
edges.logic: Questions guide financial diligence, but diligence can also start from available data.

edges.blocking_condition: critical commercial question exists
edges.enforcement: route question to commercial owner; critical status blocks IC not start
edges.logic: Questions and commercial diligence iterate.

edges.blocking_condition: finding affects earnings/cash flow/debt/working capital basis
edges.enforcement: reopen question register
edges.logic: Financial findings can invalidate or refine the original questions.

edges.blocking_condition: finding affects growth/margin/customer/exit multiple assumptions
edges.enforcement: reopen question register
edges.logic: Commercial findings can challenge growth and valuation assumptions.

edges.blocking_condition: finding affects execution feasibility, capex, synergies or KPI baseline
edges.enforcement: reopen question register
edges.logic: Operational evidence can create new diligence questions.

edges.blocking_condition: finding affects sponsor reliance, governance, management quality or alignment
edges.enforcement: reopen question register
edges.logic: Sponsor/management risk often reframes underwriting rather than simply adding a checklist item.

edges.blocking_condition: final valuation relies on earnings/cash-flow basis
edges.enforcement: allow draft model; block IC-ready valuation
edges.logic: You cannot set final valuation on an unverified or unaccepted earnings basis.

edges.blocking_condition: growth, margin, customer, or exit multiple assumptions are material to returns
edges.enforcement: block unsupported final growth/multiple assumptions
edges.logic: Commercial evidence drives growth/margin/exit multiple inputs.

edges.blocking_condition: capex, synergies, integration, or operating plan materially affects returns
edges.enforcement: require evidence/risk acceptance for operational value drivers
edges.logic: Operational feasibility changes cash flows and value creation.

edges.blocking_condition: leverage, financing condition, covenant or liquidity risk affects returns/downside
edges.enforcement: require debt/covenant terms in model or risk acceptance
edges.logic: Debt terms change return distribution and downside.

edges.blocking_condition: tax affects vehicle choice, leakage, filing obligation, or liability
edges.enforcement: hard-block structure only when material; otherwise warn
edges.logic: Tax is a blocker only where it materially changes economics or feasibility.

edges.blocking_condition: legal rights/liabilities/authority affect structure or signing
edges.enforcement: block signing if legal authority/doc consistency unresolved
edges.logic: Legal rights and liabilities must be reflected in structure and docs.

edges.blocking_condition: security/rights/fees/vehicle affect economics
edges.enforcement: require security economics before IC-ready valuation
edges.logic: Security terms and rights are part of the economics, not a legal afterthought.

edges.blocking_condition: unresolved assumption drives returns/downside or IC recommendation
edges.enforcement: reopen question register or require risk acceptance
edges.logic: The model reveals which assumptions matter and what evidence is missing.

edges.blocking_condition: investment decision concerns capital commitment or material action
edges.enforcement: block decision package without final model or exception
edges.logic: Authority needs a risk/return case.

edges.blocking_condition: critical questions unresolved and not risk-accepted
edges.enforcement: show unresolved questions and require risk acceptance
edges.logic: IC should not unknowingly approve unresolved critical uncertainty.

edges.blocking_condition: binding documents are being finalized, signed, or used to authorize funding
edges.enforcement: allow drafting; block finalization, signing, and funding before approval or a tracked conditional-authority route
edges.logic: Documentation may be prepared in parallel, but binding execution must implement an authorized decision.

edges.blocking_condition: signing/funding requires authority and doc consistency
edges.enforcement: hard-block signing if unresolved
edges.logic: Legal authority and document consistency are hard execution blockers.

edges.blocking_condition: tax structure is material to signed docs or economics
edges.enforcement: block only if material; otherwise note/warn
edges.logic: Tax can be either a true blocker or a review layer depending on materiality.

edges.blocking_condition: a position, cost basis, funding, proceeds, or ownership record is being created or changed
edges.enforcement: allow closing preparation; block position creation or cash release without executed authority and event evidence
edges.logic: Administration may be prepared in parallel, but capital and position records require executed authority or realization evidence.

edges.blocking_condition: monitoring live exposure
edges.enforcement: start monitoring when live/residual exposure exists
edges.logic: Monitoring requires a position and baseline.

edges.blocking_condition: material variance, new money, covenant/liquidity issue, exit process, impairment or time-based review
edges.enforcement: open UR/re-underwriting workflow
edges.logic: Material post-close evidence requires outcome calibration.

edges.blocking_condition: new money, sell, impairment, restructure or material valuation/action proposed
edges.enforcement: route to required authority
edges.logic: Material post-close actions need decision authority.

edges.blocking_condition: UR recommends follow-on, rescue, recapitalization, amendment or restructuring
edges.enforcement: open structure/legal execution branch
edges.logic: New-money and restructuring decisions require updated rights/security/economics.

edges.blocking_condition: approved action requires signed amendment, subscription, commitment or restructuring docs
edges.enforcement: block funding/position update until docs/evidence exist
edges.logic: Post-close action changes exposure and must be documented.

edges.blocking_condition: recommendation is hold/no action/defer or decline support while live exposure remains
edges.enforcement: reset monitoring baseline and risk flags
edges.logic: A hold decision still changes what the system should monitor.

edges.blocking_condition: current analysis recommends sell, exit, realization or write-off
edges.enforcement: open exit-realization workflow and require current sell/hold rationale and return bridge
edges.logic: An approved sell or write-off recommendation starts the exit-realization workflow.

edges.blocking_condition: sale process or realization event appears directly during monitoring
edges.enforcement: open exit workflow and require outcome analysis
edges.logic: Some exit events arise before a formal UR document is produced.

edges.blocking_condition: proceeds, write-off, partial realization or final exposure must be recorded
edges.enforcement: record proceeds/final exposure/closed status
edges.logic: Outcomes must be reconciled into capital records.

edges.blocking_condition: partial exit or residual exposure remains
edges.enforcement: keep residual position in monitoring
edges.logic: Partial realization does not close the workflow.

edges.blocking_condition: a critical operational or execution-feasibility question exists
edges.enforcement: route the question to the operational owner; unresolved critical status blocks decision, not work start
edges.logic: Questions guide operational diligence while evidence can arrive iteratively.

edges.blocking_condition: a critical management, sponsor, alignment, or governance question exists
edges.enforcement: route the question to the assessment owner; unresolved critical status blocks decision, not work start
edges.logic: Management, sponsor, and governance assessment should answer explicit decision-relevant questions.

edges.blocking_condition: a critical legal-rights, liability, authority, or documentation question exists
edges.enforcement: route the question to legal; unresolved signing-critical status blocks execution
edges.logic: Legal work should be driven by identified rights, liabilities, authority, and execution questions.

edges.blocking_condition: a potentially material tax, leakage, filing, liability, or vehicle question exists
edges.enforcement: route the question to tax; block only when the unresolved effect is material
edges.logic: Tax analysis should focus on issues capable of changing economics or execution.

edges.blocking_condition: a critical leverage, covenant, liquidity, or financing-condition question exists
edges.enforcement: route the question to financing; unresolved material status blocks final valuation or execution
edges.logic: Financing work should test the debt and liquidity assumptions that drive returns and downside.

edges.blocking_condition: a critical security, vehicle, rights, fees, or governance question exists
edges.enforcement: route the question to structuring; unresolved material status blocks final economics or documentation
edges.logic: Structure must answer the rights and economics questions created by the investment case.

edges.blocking_condition: a finding changes rights, liabilities, authority, conditions, economics, or execution feasibility
edges.enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark downstream blockers
edges.logic: Material legal findings can invalidate assumptions or require a different structure or decision.

edges.blocking_condition: a finding changes leakage, liability, vehicle choice, filing obligations, or execution feasibility
edges.enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark downstream blockers
edges.logic: Material tax findings can change economics, structure, or ability to execute.

edges.blocking_condition: a finding changes leverage, covenants, liquidity, financing certainty, returns, or downside
edges.enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark model or execution blockers
edges.logic: Financing findings can materially change the risk-return case.

edges.blocking_condition: a finding changes security economics, rights, governance, fees, ownership, or vehicle feasibility
edges.enforcement: reopen or create the affected question and mark valuation or documentation blockers
edges.logic: Structuring findings can change the economics and the rights actually being underwritten.

edges.blocking_condition: debt commitments, covenants, financing conditions, or security arrangements are part of closing
edges.enforcement: block final documentation or closing only when financing terms are material to execution
edges.logic: Material financing terms and conditions must be implemented consistently in the transaction documents.

edges.blocking_condition: transaction documents implement security, ownership, governance, fee, or investor-rights terms
edges.enforcement: allow drafting; block finalization and signing until the approved structure is reflected
edges.logic: Transaction documents must implement the actual security, rights, governance, and economic structure.

edges.blocking_condition: tax leakage, liability, blocker costs, or vehicle choice materially affects returns or feasibility
edges.enforcement: require the material tax effect in the final model or a RiskAcceptanceRecord
edges.logic: Material tax effects change net cash flows, return outputs, or transaction feasibility.

execution_policy.parallelism: Diligence, control, structuring, and draft-model workstreams may run in parallel after screening and question planning; final valuation, approval, signing, funding, and close remain blocked by material unresolved dependencies.
execution_policy.materiality: Conditional edges must evaluate whether a dependency is model-critical, rights-critical, tax-material, execution-critical, or decision-critical before blocking.
execution_policy.iteration: The QuestionRegister is an active reasoning service, not a one-time stage artifact. Any material workstream or model finding must create or reopen the affected question.
execution_policy.authority: A RiskAcceptanceRecord may release a blocker only when the configured authority has accepted the specific unresolved risk, scope, and downstream consequence.
execution_policy.post_close: Monitoring, re-underwriting, authority, execution, capital administration, exit realization, and residual monitoring form controlled loops rather than a linear tail.
